silhouette.reason: Unmistakable T-34: sloped glacis and sides, five Christie wheels plus idler and sprocket, hex turret with twin cupola hatches, F-34 gun, rear drums/exhausts. Reads from all six views and LOD2.
fixes: soften the turret edges (cast radius) so it is not a sharp-edged box

proportions.reason: Within the 6.68 x 3.00 x 2.45 m spec; wheel, track and barrel measures pass.
fixes: check the turret ring position against a side elevation

materials.reason: Track links now read as dark steel and the dot chips are gone. The hull carries a mottled khaki/green dust layer that in hero.png and the sheet TOP reads as a printed camouflage pattern (pixel-blocky in TOP) rather than dust settling on horizontal faces; road wheels are uniformly dust-tan including the hub caps.
fixes: dust only on up-facing plates and lower hull, fading with height (grime ground/up masks) instead of an all-over mottle
rubber tyres darker than the dusted wheel discs

detail.reason: Raking.png: link track with horns, dished wheels with ribs, grab rails, spare links, hatches, MG ball, fuel drums with straps, exhausts, slogan; no weld beads at plate joints, no tow cable.
fixes: tow cable along the hull side

wear.reason: Dusty wheels and running gear and a weathered hull now give a field story; the dust is all-over rather than where it would settle, and the exhausts leave no soot on the rear plate.
fixes: exhaust soot on the rear plate
mud heaviest on the lower hull and track run, lighter up the sides

lod.reason: lods.png: LOD2 keeps the outline and turret, but the dust-tan road wheels become green faceted slabs and the hull mottle goes flat green, so the running gear changes colour at the switch.
fixes: keep the road-wheel discs dust-tan at LOD2 (same vertex/tile colour as LOD0)
bake the hull mottle into LOD2 colour or remove it from LOD0

technical.reason: QA PASS: 58.1k / 12.6k / 1.49k tris, 19 draws (one per moving pivot), one material.
fixes: declare real.mass (26.5 t) and a physics shell so the mass gate covers it
